text: You can make an Opportunity Attack when a creature that you can see leaves your reach using its action, its Bonus Action, its Reaction, or one of its speeds. To make the Opportunity Attack, take a Reaction to make one melee attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike against the provoking creature. The attack occurs right before the creature leaves your reach. *See also* “Playing the Game” (“Combat”).

then.note: One melee attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, right before the creature leaves your reach.
